title: Declare a testing witness for every implementation component

facts.note: Implementation components are identified by the traceability closure validator (atdd_traceability_closure) from source files in scope.
Diff-level observer needed to know which identified components were added or touched in this change; the closure validator itself checks all identified components.
Validator finding that an identified component lacks a declared testing witness.

fires: A new implementation component is added and the traceability closure validator identifies it as a component
An existing identified implementation component has no declared testing witness when the closure check runs
doesNotFire: Files the traceability closure validator does not identify as implementation components (e.g. test files themselves)
Checking whether a declared witness actually resolves to an existing test (that is traceability.source.tested-by-resolves)

given: An implementation component identified by the traceability closure check
when: The component is created or changed, or the closure check runs
then: The component declares a testing witness.
prefer: Declare the testing witness in the same change that introduces the component, naming the test that exercises it
avoid: Leaving an identified implementation component with no declared testing witness
Declaring a placeholder or unrelated witness just to satisfy the presence check
why: Traceability closure requires every implementation component to point to the test that witnesses it; a witness can only be resolved and checked once it is declared.
evidence: The atdd_traceability_closure validator reports no identified implementation component without a declared testing witness
verifier_detail: Implemented as a validator: atdd_traceability_closure. It identifies implementation components and fails each one lacking a declared testing witness.

sharedNodes.text: strict: fails on every finding, no advisory mode, no ratchet baseline.
